name: Glacial Heart

Traits.name: Glacial Glide
Traits.text: The heart can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the heart doesn't disturb the material it moves through. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice, snow, and frozen ground doesn't cost the heart extra movement.
Traits.expresses: a body of ancient glacial ice

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the heart fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The heart makes three Slam attacks.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 15 ft. 17 (2d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Cold damage.

Actions.name: Glacial Breach (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 22, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the heart. *Failure:* 97 (15d12) Cold damage. *Success:* Half damage.
Actions.gmQuote: something enormous and patient under the ice

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the heart takes the Hide action.

Legendary Actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
Legendary Actions.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, the heart can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Legendary Actions.name: Welling Lunge
Legendary Actions.text: The heart moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Slam attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Sink Deep
Legendary Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the heart takes the Hide action. The heart can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Legendary Actions.name: Glare Down
Legendary Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 22, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: A heart of black glacial ice that sleeps beneath the last ice of an endless winter, taking one meal a century and remembering every village that ever cut a hole above it.
